title: The Four Powers that grieve
text:
⟨p.147⟩
(ornament)
(ornament) > The Four Powers of Those Who Grieve < (ornament)
{11} again the Illuminator said to his disciples: I am one
single in those who grieve, in the three powers that are inclined of heart,
which have come forth from the Father. The first who grieves is the first Mo-
ther of the Living One: she takes pity, indeed, on account of her children who
stand in tribulation, having been mingled with the Darkness and the
{12}, bound up in the entire archonic host. Therefore she grieves, being
{13} with longing for them as they receive the tribulations. The time when she s-
{14}es them in suffering upon them, she habitually grieves and mou{15} for them.
{16} who is grieved {17} heart is the First Man, whose
{18} and his Kingship are established in the Vessel of Li-
{19} he himself also grieves in heart on account of
⟨p.148⟩
his five sons who stand fast in the midst of the dan-
-ger; for every chosen one who is pleasing to them — that they not be afflicted —
weighs upon their five. Every time when they hear the voice of their
weeping when they cry forth on account of the bondages and the blows
of the Enemy that come upon them daily, befalling them —
in this manner at every time he bears grief and mourning on account of his
sons.
The third one who grieves, which is myself —
since from the time when I came to the cosmos, joy has not
come to be in me within it. On account of the holy Church which I
chose in the name of my Father — I made her free from the
comportment of the Powers; I added in her
the Mind of Light. Every time when I see {4} undergoing
affliction and persecution, being afflicted by her enemie{5}
I bear compassion for her. I have also another grief there,
besides this — concerning the souls who have not received the hope
and have not strengthened themselves in this firmness and this standing-fast of
{6} — they shall come forth and go astray, and shall depart up to
Gehenna for ever. On account of this indeed I grieve for them, because
they did not receive repentance and did not join themselves with the right hand of
the Peace and the Mercy that I brought forth from the Father.
